svg.text: Species and mutations: what can be carried between universes
A set lives in one universe and cannot be moved. A species is only a rule for building something, so it can be run in any universe; a mutation is a rule that turns one species into
another. Below, an outline is a species, and the hatch that fills it is the universe it happens to be run in.
Same outlines, same arrows, different lines inside. The outlines and arrows are all that
The 19 species and 13 mutations of the toolkit
double arrow: a core mutation, the same seen from every universe · loop: a mutation from a species to itself
outline only: a type, not a set
Every chip names a data type of the toolkit (species ids of `iut species`, C structs of src/iut.h). All numbers are read from `iut walk`.
